docs.text: FastAPI reads request bodies as JSON, converts types, validates data, and returns clear errors when input is invalid.
FastAPI generates an OpenAPI schema and interactive API documentation from declared routes and data models.
FastAPI dependency injection lets route operations declare shared requirements such as authentication and database access.
Qdrant stores vectors with payload metadata and persists collections on disk for later search.
Qdrant payload filters can constrain vector search by metadata fields before results are returned.
Qdrant collections configure vector size and a distance function such as cosine similarity.
Python hashlib provides secure hash algorithms including SHA-256 for stable content fingerprints.
Python urllib.request opens URLs and sends HTTP requests without an additional package.
Python dataclasses generate methods for classes that primarily store typed data.
Uvicorn is an ASGI web server implementation for running Python asynchronous web applications.
Uvicorn supports worker processes and production process-manager configurations.
Container health probes should check whether the application can serve requests, not only whether its process exists.
